high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "tooonytoony," posted 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The photo is set against a backdrop of a clear blue sky and a waterfront scene with several boats docked in the background. The main subject of the image is a person standing by the water, facing away from the camera. They have long, dark hair that flows down their back and is partially held up by one hand. The person is wearing a sleeveless black dress that reaches the ground.
